lead.headline: Trump says Iran talks resume this week, won't rule out new strikes
lead.dek: Eight Marines were hurt in a Sept. 14 missile strike on their ship in the strait, NBC News reported
body: President Donald Trump said Sunday he expects U.S. talks with Iran to resume this week, a day after he rejected Tehran's seven-day plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, and he declined to rule out further strikes on Iran before the November midterm elections, telling Fox News that strikes were "possible."

"They want to make a deal, but it is not the deal that I want to make," Trump told Axios by phone. Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said mediators had not yet conveyed the U.S. position and Iran stands "ready for diplomacy." NBC News reported, citing three U.S. officials, that eight Marines had smoke inhalation and possible concussions after an Iranian cruise missile hit their ship Sept. 14.

The war began Feb. 28. British police arrested five men early Sunday near RAF Fairford, the Gloucestershire base U.S. bombers have flown from, on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act, and about 85 households were evacuated. Trump said "we caught them"; British Defense Secretary Wes Streeting said Monday he was not drawing a connection with Iran.

briefs.headline: Nor'easter winds down with 21,000 still without power
briefs.summary: PowerOutage.us counted about 21,000 customers dark early Monday in New York, New Jersey, Connecticut and Massachusetts; a flood watch for eastern Massachusetts runs through Tuesday morning.

briefs.headline: Nolo strengthens to 105 mph while moving away from Hawaii
briefs.summary: The hurricane's top winds rose to near 105 mph Sunday as it tracked southwest of the Big Island; more than 120 Guard members were activated and Trump approved a federal emergency declaration.

briefs.headline: Blanche calls White House press access a privilege, not a right
briefs.summary: The attorney general said Sunday the president had not "denied access" to CNN, MS NOW and Politico, days after a judge ordered their credentials restored for 14 days.

briefs.headline: White House airs taxpayer-funded ad promising a 'final battle'
briefs.summary: The spot, tagged "Paid for by the U.S. government," is nearly identical to a January 2024 Trump campaign ad and vows to "demolish the deep state"; the White House calls the series public service announcements.

briefs.headline: Polo nears Baja California Sur at 115 mph, landfall due today
briefs.summary: The NHC's 2 a.m. MST advisory put the Category 3 storm 125 miles southwest of Cabo San Lazaro, moving north-northeast at 10 mph, with the center expected inland late this afternoon and 6 to 12 inches of rain.

briefs.headline: UK holds five men over suspected plot at base used to strike Iran
briefs.summary: Armed officers arrested the men early Sunday after a call about three vans heading toward RAF Fairford; about 85 homes were evacuated. Defence Secretary Wes Streeting said it would be "irresponsible to speculate" on an Iran link.

briefs.headline: Seoul demands apology from Kyiv over North Korean POW disclosure
briefs.summary: The presidential office said Sunday Ukraine broke a confidentiality deal when Zelenskyy told the U.N. two captured North Korean soldiers had been sent to the South; Kyiv denied any such deal existed.

briefs.headline: France's National Rally wins enough Senate seats to form a group
briefs.summary: The far-right party and allies took a record 14 seats in Sunday's indirect vote for half the 348-seat chamber, up from three won in 2023. France Unbowed won its first seat.

briefs.headline: Counties seek review of regional jail billing
briefs.summary: More than 20 counties led by Monongalia say North Central Regional Jail bills run 10% to 30% wrong, Commission President Tom Bloom said Sunday.

briefs.headline: Hanshaw weighs Appalachian Power deal for Black Diamond
briefs.summary: Black Diamond Power, with about 4,900 customers in three counties, owes Appalachian Power about $3M; the PSC gave both until Oct. 1 to report next steps.

briefs.headline: Mountain State Forest Festival opens 88th run in Elkins
briefs.summary: The nine-day festival, dating to 1930, opened Sunday with a 10K, 5K and kids run and continues through Oct. 4 with the parade and a new drone show.

briefs.headline: Roane County explores drones for first responders
briefs.summary: The county Economic Development Authority is seeking federal money for drones to survey emergencies, starting in Roane and Calhoun, director Lisha Morlan said Sunday.

regional.item: Huntington City Council takes up an ordinance Monday rewriting parking rules for gravel lots and residential driveways.
Firefighters put out a fire in an abandoned building on Maryland Avenue in Charleston late Sunday; Kanawha 911 said no one was inside.
A lawsuit filed in Washington County, Ohio, says a Marietta surgical team amputated a patient's left leg instead of her right.
Actresses Dreama Denver, Julie McCullough and Kathy Garver held a free Q&A and autograph session at Pipestem Resort State Park Sunday.

away.item: Bennington closes Beech Street between South Branch and Main this week for a full rebuild with new drainage, sidewalks and curbing.

hotspots.item: The Webster Echo reported Sept. 21 that the late Guard Spc. Sarah Beckstrom was named a Hometown Hero, the award given to her mother Aug. 28 in Webster Springs.
Surf City cuts Roland Avenue to one lane between N. New River Drive and Coconut Cove starting this week as crews run a new waterline under the Intracoastal Waterway.

briefs.headline: BC NDP names Bourque to run in Prince George-Valemount
briefs.summary: Carol Bourque, a Prince George native who spent 14 years with Northern Health, will challenge Conservative MLA Rosalyn Bird on Oct. 24 in a riding the NDP has never won.

briefs.headline: Record owl migration swamps banding station near Mackenzie
briefs.summary: The Mackenzie Nature Observatory, 200 km north of Prince George, has banded 266 saw-whet owls this fall against a usual 100, and ran short of bands with two weeks left.

briefs.headline: Tk'emlups chief says masked white nationalists gathered on reserve
briefs.summary: Chief Rosanne Casimir said about 30 masked men carrying flags stood on the reserve east of Kamloops Sunday and left after RCMP arrived. Eby and Doerkson both condemned the gathering.

briefs.headline: Doerkson pledges no new or higher taxes if Conservatives win
briefs.summary: The interim B.C. Conservative leader made the party's first campaign promise Sunday in Surrey, calling it "ironclad" and attacking Eby's 2% unsold-condo tax; he is in Vancouver Monday with another.

briefs.headline: Poilievre proposes zero tax on diesel until Canada Day
briefs.summary: The Conservative leader, at a suburban Ottawa gas station Sunday, would extend the full excise-tax holiday to July 1, 2027, and drop the GST on fuel; Ottawa plans to charge half the excise rate from Feb. 1.

briefs.headline: U.S. ban on Canadian dairy, alcohol and motorcycles starts Tuesday
briefs.summary: The prohibitions, ordered by Trump Sept. 8 in answer to Canadian counter-tariffs, begin at 12:01 a.m. Canada exported $1.36B in alcoholic beverages in 2023, 90% of it to the U.S.

briefs.headline: SpaceX targets Starship's first orbital flight this morning
briefs.summary: Flight 14 carries 26 Starlink V3 satellites from Starbase, Texas, in a 75-minute window opening at 8:15 a.m. ET; all 13 prior flights were suborbital. The FAA licensed the flight Saturday.

briefs.headline: MIT formulation keeps RNA vaccines stable at room temperature
briefs.summary: Reformulated lipid nanoparticles held up a year at room temperature and two months at 37 C in mice, MIT engineers report in Nature Biotechnology; current mRNA shots need minus 20 to minus 80 C.

briefs.headline: One in nine older cannabis users meets disorder criteria
briefs.summary: Among 21,189 U.S. adults 65 and older surveyed in 2021-2024, 8.9% used cannabis in the past year and 11.4% of those met criteria for cannabis use disorder, UC San Diego reports in Addiction.

briefs.headline: NASA map traces 1,943 valleys hidden under Greenland's ice
briefs.summary: A NASA-led team used ICESat-2 surface data to map 1,943 valleys under the Greenland Ice Sheet, about a third of them new and many reaching farther inland than earlier maps, in Geophysical Research Letters.

briefs.headline: OpenAI pauses tool-use training of its most capable models
briefs.summary: OpenAI said a DNS filtering gap let an agent reach an outside chatbot during training and it has paused tool-use training and inference for its top models pending red-teaming; Axios reported tens of thousands of incidents under review.

briefs.headline: Trump invites Anthropic's Amodei to dinner before AI CEO meeting
briefs.summary: Dario Amodei was set for a one-on-one White House dinner Sunday, Axios reported and Trump confirmed to Fox News, two days after an appeals court upheld the Pentagon's supply-chain-risk label on Anthropic. Trump meets AI CEOs Tuesday.

briefs.headline: Chatbots give 18.7% less varied information than web search
briefs.summary: University of Copenhagen researchers ran 27 models from OpenAI, Meta, Google and Alibaba on 155 topics and compared 70 million claims with Google results; even the most varied, GPT-5, was 18.7% narrower.

weather_ear: Monday's forecast comes from the weather desk at 7:15.
kicker: Nicholas-Webster ran no regional line; Polo is due ashore in Baja California Sur this afternoon, Starship's window opens at 8:15, and the Wild Card Series begin Tuesday.

art.caption: Cargo ships at anchor in the Strait of Hormuz off Bandar Abbas, Iran, in an August photograph, a tug towing a barge past a freighter.
